title: Sellers by likes
prompt:
Write `SellersByLikes(names []string, likes []int) []string`. `likes[i]` belongs to `names[i]`. Return names ordered by likes, most first, with ties in alphabetical order. Don't modify the inputs. If the lengths differ, return `nil`.

`[S1 S2 S3]`, `[18 15 17]` → `[S1 S3 S2]`
hint: Sort a slice of indices with `slices.SortFunc` and `cmp.Or(cmp.Compare(...), ...)`.
